newsitem.title: USA: Pinnacle, Indiana Federal, CB Bancorp close merger.
newsitem.headline: Pinnacle, Indiana Federal, CB Bancorp close merger.

text.p: Pinnacle Financial Services Inc, Indiana Federal Corp and CB Bancorp Inc said Monday a merger of the three financial services company was effective August 1.

The new $2.2 billion entity will operate under the name Pinnacle Financial Services Inc and will be located in Valparaiso, Ind. The largest subsidiary of the corporation, Pinnacle Bank, will continue to be headquartered in St. Joseph, Mich.
Shareholders at each of the companies approved the transactions at meetings on July 30, 1997.
Through Pinnacle Bank, a full range of financial services will be offered via a network of 47 sales centers and 45 ATMs extending from Southwestern Michigan to the Illinois state line.
The Pinnacle/Indiana Federal plan to merge was announced last November, and the CB Bancorp merger was initiated in March.

Richard Schanze, currently Pinnacle chairman, will serve as chairman of the board, and Donald Lesch, Indiana Federal chairman, will assume the duties of vice chairman/president. Pinnacle Financial Services's board of directors will be comprised of five representatives from Pinnacle's previous board, five representatives from Indiana Federal and one previous CB Bancorp board member.
